definitions.explanation: For plants, hair, or teeth to emerge and develop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|は}えている。

examples.english: Teeth have started to come in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髭|ひげ}→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|は}えてきた。
examples.english: A beard has started to grow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧{生|は}えている。
examples.english: A lot of weeds are growing in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カビ→カビ：07055_kabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|は}えて⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Mold has grown on the old bread, so there's no choice but to throw it away.

notes:
{生|は}える means for something to grow or sprout naturally.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {生|は}やす (transitive - to grow, let grow)

WHAT CAN {生|は}える:
- {草|くさ}が{生|は}える: grass grows
- {歯|は}が{生|は}える: teeth come in
- {髭|ひげ}が{生|は}える: beard grows
- {髪|かみ}が{生|は}える: hair grows
- カビが{生|は}える: mold grows

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜が{生|は}えている: ~ is growing (state)
- 〜が{生|は}えてきた: ~ has started to grow

HOMOPHONE DISTINCTION:
- {生|は}える: to grow (plants, hair, teeth)
- {映|は}える: to look good, to stand out
